summary: The group holds 346 rows: 157 regular files (132 PIE executables and 17 shared-object-format executables, plus 8 scripts) and 189 symlinks, spread over vendor_a (241), system_ext_a (55), odm_a (38), system_a (10) and product_a (2). The core is a toybox multi-call binary (172 applet symlinks) and a toolbox multi-call binary (6 symlinks), an mksh shell, a vendor binder service manager, and 14 HAL service executables (10 in vendor_a/bin/hw, 4 in odm_a/bin/hw) that register HIDL or AIDL interfaces and are started by init services. The odm partition carries the SyncBoss sensor-controller toolset: fw_init, a oneshot firmware updater that reads /odm/etc/fw_init.cfg, plus 17 shared-object-format tools that each export main. system_ext_a carries 50 platform service and command-line executables and 4 shell wrappers; product_a carries 2 crash-uploader executables. All 157 files match the manifest sha256 and byte size, and init or SELinux text references 62 of them by full path. Commands in the evidence run with the mount root as working directory: <image>/mnt.
